name: Bruck am Ziller
kurzbeschreibung: Tiny village right on the Ziller with a lakeside bath and perfect location between Fügen and Zell.
beschreibung:
Bruck am Ziller lies at 579 meters above sea level in the lower Zillertal, nestled between the tourism centers of Fügen to the west and Zell am Ziller to the east. The market town in the district of Schwaz has around 1,100 residents and is one of the quieter places in the valley, without being off the beaten path – the Zillertalbahn stops right in the village, and the Inntalautobahn can be reached in just a few minutes.

The heart of the village is undoubtedly the swimming lake, a popular excursion destination for families from all over the valley. With a sunbathing lawn, playground, and clear mountain air, it offers a real alternative in summer to the bustle of the larger neighboring communities. Hikers start from Bruck directly into the Zillertal mountains – the Hochzillertal-Bergbahn is only a few kilometers away and opens up over 100 kilometers of hiking trails. Mountain bikers appreciate the central location as a starting point for tours into the Inntal or over the slopes of the Spieljoch. The Zillertaler Radweg also runs through the village.

In culinary terms, regional Zillertal cuisine plays a major role, from Kaspressknödeln to Zillertaler Krapfen, which are served in the inns around the village square. Anyone seeking peace and quiet, away from the heavily frequented tourism hotspots, will find in Bruck am Ziller an authentic retreat with direct access to all the highlights of the Zillertal. 🏘️
